title: Puffy Remotion Video Props
description: Input properties schema for the Remotion programmatic video composition pipeline.

durationInFrames.description: Total composition duration in frames (default: 300 frames / 10s @ 30fps).

kenBurnsZoomIntensity.description: Ken Burns background zoom scale factor (constrained to 1.05 - 1.2).

mattressLayerTransition.description: Animation transition preset for the unaltered mattress cutout layer.

brandBadgeAsset.description: Relative path to the brand badge/logo asset in assets/logos/.
